verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a public API reference, with an agent-readable markdown version, and also ships an official MCP server and CLI, so programmatic access is clearly available. Nothing in the pack shows that every UI capability can be done through the API, and probes did not find a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the common paths on the docs domain. Missing for 10: an explicit or demonstrated UI-to-API parity claim, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI workflows (dashboards, monitors, incidents, etc.) are fully automatable via the API.
